summary.text: Heidi Kasama is a Republican Nevada Assemblymember for District 2 in Clark County, first elected in November 2020. The legislature lists her occupation as Realtor and her committees in the 2025 session as Commerce and Labor, Growth and Infrastructure, and Natural Resources.

paragraphs.text: The Nevada Legislature says Kasama was born in New York, New York, and holds a B.S. in accounting from Central Washington University.
Her page lists her as president of the Las Vegas Association of Realtors in 2014 and of the Nevada Association of Realtors in 2018, and as Nevada Realtor of the Year in 2015.
Kasama began serving in the Nevada Assembly in 2021.
Her 2021 committee assignments were Commerce and Labor, Judiciary and Revenue, and her 2023 assignments were Commerce and Labor, Growth and Infrastructure, and Ways and Means.
